package notifier

import (
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"
)

func TestI8R19InjectedCapturedCallback(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		bus := NewEventBus()
		sub := &mockSubscriber{}
		bus.Subscribe(EventSyncError, sub)
		captured, release := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
		i8r19BeforeLaunch = func() { close(captured); <-release }
		defer func() { i8r19BeforeLaunch = nil }()
		published := make(chan struct{})
		go func() { bus.Publish(Event{Type: EventSyncError}); close(published) }()
		<-captured
		stopped := make(chan struct{}, 4)
		for range 4 {
			go func() { bus.DrainSubscribers(); stopped <- struct{}{} }()
		}
		synctest.Wait()
		if len(stopped) != 0 {
			t.Error("I8R19_BEHAVIOR: drain missed captured callback before launch")
		}
		close(release)
		<-published
		for range 4 {
			<-stopped
		}
		if sub.count() != 1 {
			t.Error("I8R19_BEHAVIOR: admitted callback lost")
		}
		bus.Publish(Event{Type: EventSyncError})
		bus.DrainSubscribers()
		synctest.Wait()
		if sub.count() != 1 {
			t.Error("I8R19_BEHAVIOR: callback admitted after freeze")
		}
	})
}
